text: Training goal：Based in China and facing the world, to cultivate middle and senior information talents with good humanities and social science literacy, international vision and teamwork spirit, with systematic, solid and broad theoretical foundation of computer science, and with strong engineering implementation ability and innovation ability. Graduates have the ability to engage in applied research, design, development and management of computer science and technology in the information technology industry, scientific research departments and related fieldscore courses：Professional introduction, Database Principle and application, Software engineering Foundation, algorithm design and analysis, software quality assurance and testing, software architecture, software project management
